head: 7f01b165095799a6044e1db90abb66f53b6d7449
title: Give invoices a due date and mark the late ones overdue
reason: The new status and the backfill need a person, and one test covers the overdue rule.

waiting.title: A new enum value reaches every client
waiting.detail: InvoiceStatus gains OVERDUE, which a client with an exhaustive switch rejects.

waiting.title: The backfill rewrites every sent invoice
waiting.detail: One UPDATE sets due_on for all sent invoices in a single transaction.

risks.title: Old clients see an unknown status
risks.impact: A client built before OVERDUE existed receives a status it cannot display.

risks.title: The backfill locks the invoices table
risks.impact: The UPDATE touches every sent invoice in one statement, so invoice writes wait for it.

risks.title: Due today is not overdue
risks.impact: MarkOverdue uses Before, so an invoice due on the run date stays SENT.
risks.guard: The test only covers an invoice due the day before.

decisions.question: Is it OK to ship `OVERDUE` before every client handles it?
decisions.why: A client with an exhaustive switch on `InvoiceStatus` rejects a value it does not know.
decisions.suggestion: Yes, if the web client ships in the same release.

ticketFit.summary: The overdue rule is tested; the backfill and the list column are only in the code.

criteria.text: Mark a sent invoice overdue once its due date passes
Give every sent invoice a due date
Show the due date in the invoice list

areas.name: API contract
areas.summary: Adds a due date, an OVERDUE status and a mutation that applies it.

facts.text: OVERDUE is a new enum value

areas.name: Migrations
areas.summary: Adds invoices.due_on and backfills it from sent_at.

after.text: Run markOverdue once and compare the count with the billing report

notes.text: Consider comparing dates rather than instants.

evidencePlan.claim: markOverdue moves only past-due sent invoices
evidencePlan.how: Call the mutation against a seeded database and list the moved invoices.

uncertain: Whether 30 days is the right default term for every customer
